{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue_clean == 999999.99)
qa_mask = sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99

# Check if any QA orders are in the 'loyal' segment
qa_loyal = sales[qa_mask & (sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal')]
print("QA orders among loyal customers:", qa_loyal)

# Now, compute the conversion fraction among loyal customers, including all rows with customer_segment == 'loyal'
loyal_customers = sales[sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']
n_converted = loyal_customers['converted'].sum()
n_total = len(loyal_customers)
conversion_fraction = n_converted / n_total

print(f"Total loyal customers (including QA): {n_total}")
print(f"Converted loyal customers (including QA): {n_converted}")
print(f"Conversion fraction among loyal customers (including QA): {conversion_fraction:.4f}")"}
